messages.subject: Spatio-Temporal modeling
parts:
I am new in spatial temporal modeling. I would like to request help on sample codes and the corresponding data. I have some idea as to the models I can use for the temporal effect (rw1,AR etc) but I would like to know how the data set is arranged, say I have a dataset on HIV for 2000,2005,2010,2015, with the same covariates and locations. How do I combine these 4 datasets so as to incorporate the time effect as in (but not limited to) the model below
 the example on the paper "Spatial and spatio-temporal models with R-INLA" by Marta Blangiardo,Michela Cameletti,Gianluca Baio and Håvard Rue,
 formula3 <- y~1 + f(ID.area,model="bym",graph=Georgia.adj) + f(ID.year,model="rw1") +f(ID.year1,model="iid") + f(ID.area.year,model="iid")
Thanks
